text:
michelle: Quick pulse — we need to lock owners & blockers for the token-cost attribution work before the canary cut next Tue. Schema looks good but ingestion mapping for `token.weights` is missing in s3->kinesis job.

samir: I can take owner for the schema and rollouts (canary plan + rollback tags). Kevin, can you own the ingestion mapping? pinging since this touches your pipeline.

kevin: I can pick it up but need the exact field mapping and an example event. Do we want to preserve old `token_count` field for a transition window?

michelle: Yes keep `token_count` for 2 weeks with a migration flag: `deprecated_token_count=true`. New canonical field is `token.weights` (array of floats) + `token.model_variant`.

anika: Also a quick Q re latency breakdowns — do we add a separate event for KV-cache hits or augment existing `llm.latency` with `kv_cache_hit: true|false`? Prefer augment to avoid event explosion.

samir: agree with augmenting `llm.latency` with `kv_cache_hit` and `batch_size`. Add `stage: [ingest, queue, model, postproc]` for clearer SLO dashboards.

kevin: OK I'll update the ingestion job and add a feature flag `feat.token_weights` behind deploy. Will open PR today. linking draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1823

michelle: timeline check — PR + unit tests by EOD tomorrow, canary config by Mon AM, cut canary Tue 10:00am PST. If any blockers speak now. :clock1:

instr-bot: reminder — canary window configured for eng-platform on Tue 10:00-14:00 PST. Auto rollback on >3% error-rate.

anika: one small ask — please add a quick example snippet in the PR description of a full `llm.latency` event with the new fields. makes QA easier.

kevin: will do, example in the PR body and integration tests covering `deprecated_token_count` toggles.

michelle: awesome. owners: samir (schema & rollout), kevin (ingest), anika (latency/qa). I'll coordinate canary monitor dash. If nothing else we'll sync Wed for post-canary notes. :+1:

samir: noted. I'll update the ownership doc and add the postmortem checklist template.

kevin: starting work now, will post PR link updates in this thread.

michelle: thanks team — update here if timelines slip.
